blocks.text: Hollywood couple Amanda Seyfried and Thomas Sadoski have confirmed their separation after nearly a decade of marriage. The actors announced their split in a joint statement sent exclusively to People Magazine on Tuesday, Sept. 15, saying they had been separated for some time. “We have been separated for a while, and it’s proven to be the right move for us and our family unit. We’ve got each other forever—and it’s GOOD,” they said. Seyfried and Sadoski did not disclose when they separated or what led to the decision. They also did not confirm whether either of them has filed for divorce. […]... Keep on reading: Amanda Seyfried, Thomas Sadoski split after 9 years of marriage
